modelStatus: Skeleton page defaults to local MoveNet MultiPose for multi-person pose inference. It keeps local MoveNet Thunder as a single-person high-accuracy mode and local MoveNet Lightning as the final single-pose fallback. Action page defaults to a local pose-sequence softmax classifier over generated frame keypoints. Preset samples are fallback only; mechanism page remains preset teaching data.

runtimeModels.label: TensorFlow.js MoveNet MultiPose Lightning
runtimeModels.runtime: TensorFlow.js CPU backend by default; WebGL script is available as an acceleration option
runtimeModels.note: Loaded automatically from the local Flask static route on /human-pose/skeleton. This is the default model for detecting up to 6 people.

runtimeModels.label: TensorFlow.js MoveNet SinglePose Thunder
runtimeModels.runtime: TensorFlow.js CPU backend by default; WebGL script is available as an acceleration option
runtimeModels.note: Used by the single-person high-accuracy mode on /human-pose/skeleton. MultiPose remains the default when the page is opened.

runtimeModels.label: TensorFlow.js MoveNet SinglePose Lightning
runtimeModels.runtime: TensorFlow.js CPU backend by default; WebGL script is available as an acceleration option
runtimeModels.note: Used only as a local fallback when the Thunder detector cannot be created. If both local models fail, the page labels the state as preset fallback and keeps preset samples visible.

runtimeModels.label: Local Pose Sequence Action Classifier
runtimeModels.runtime: Vanilla JavaScript linear softmax over pose-sequence features
runtimeModels.source: Project-trained lightweight classifier from synthetic teaching pose sequences
runtimeModels.note: The page loads local weights and runs a real forward pass for probability bars. It is not presented as a pretrained C3D/MoViNet video classifier.
